title: FRONTIER GATE · BATTLE BRIEFING
threat: A Gatebreaker is pressing through the Frontier Gate. The Vanguard deploys only when you choose Deploy; the live ETA begins then.

rule_sections.heading: 1 · LINE MAKES MP
rule_sections.body: Clear LINE rows to recover MP: no clear / Single / Double / Triple / Four = 0 / 10 / 22 / 36 / 52 MP. MP caps at 60; overflow does not convert.

rule_sections.heading: 2 · CHAIN MAKES COMBO
rule_sections.body: Swap orthogonally adjacent symbols. A valid CHAIN is a straight same-symbol 3+ line horizontally, vertically, or on either diagonal. Each resolved wave grants Combo +1 (cap 10), then MP = (sum of maximal qualified line lengths − 3) + post-wave Combo.

rule_sections.heading: 3 · FAILED CHAIN CHOICE
rule_sections.body: A no-match normally reverts the board and resets Combo. You may instead pay fixed 1 MP to keep that swap for a later setup. The lock still resets Combo and grants no clear, cascade, Combo, or MP reward.

rule_sections.heading: 4 · CURRENT COMBO SKILL
rule_sections.body: Open Skill to pause the simulation. Choose ATK, DEF, or SUP: your current Combo resolves one stage in that category. If MP is short, only surplus Combo may convert at 5 MP each to the highest feasible lower stage. Preview is free; only CONFIRM spends the displayed MP and Combo.

rule_sections.heading: 5 · TWO DIFFERENT TIME EFFECTS
rule_sections.body: Player board opportunity affects only LINE gravity and lock. Current enemy ETA affects only the visible current Gatebreaker action. The preview always names what changes and what stays unchanged.

rule_sections.heading: DEPLOY
rule_sections.body: After Deploy, this is the real continuous encounter: read the Telegraph and ETA, earn MP in LINE, make Combo in CHAIN, then make one deliberate CONFIRM. No separate tutorial board or economy replaces the encounter.
